newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 11.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 11.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The chairman of parliament's health committee said amendments to a draft law on health insurance will put state and privately run healthcare companies on an equal footing to receive financing from the state health insurance fund.
- A seminar on democratic and political security and the control of military structures is taking place in parliament.
- Lithuanian observers are taking part in a meeting of experts from the trans-European railway working group in Hungary.
